description: This file contains LESS mixins used for styling FontAwesome icons and border-radius, as well as icon stacking styles.

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Defines icon styling with a given icon content, utilizing the icon-FontAwesome mixin.

methods.name: icon-FontAwesome
methods.description: Applies FontAwesome font styles and smoothing, fixing IE7 issues.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Applies border-radius with vendor prefixes for cross-browser compatibility.

methods.name: icon-stack
methods.description: Defines styles for stacking icons with configurable width, height, and font sizes.
